the US Treasury and the Fed will do *WHATEVER IT TAKES* to get US borrowing costs (i.e., long-term bond yields) back under control to save confidence in the USD

this means (de facto) printing a shit load of money through issuing new short-term debt, issuing swap lines to governments whose economies are being wrecked by the Iran war, buying foreign currencies so they don't sell US debt, etc.

these actions are INFLATIONARY, so the assets to own are CRYPTO and GOLD

and in particular, if you believe onchain tokenization of USD (backed by US treasuries/debt) will be a critical part of the strategy to create new demand for US treasuries/debt,

then you want to OWN ETH specifically since Ethereum (by far) has the largest amount of stablecoins on it and has the best shot at being the credibly neutral global settlement layer for decentralized assets

this doesn't mean stocks can't keep going up for a while, but it also means that perhaps they don't remain the fastest runner forever

we are in a critical pivot point for many asset markets

thank you for pushing CLARITY and helping get crypto embedded into the financial institutions and into the hands of hundreds of millions of people

imo, you guys are catching strays because you don't understand or don't care about "hodler" culture. i.e., people who are often your recurring customers

Coinbase has been treated unfairly in some of this discussion, but if you do two simple things, you'll turn it around:

1) take a meaningful percentage of your Base sequencer revenues and perpetually ADD to your ETH stack on an ongoing basis
2) at least occasionally, talk about Ethereum publicly as the global settlement layer you are already using it as and ETH as a programmable store of value which you've built dozens of use cases around on Base

most people who use Base are big ETH holders and fans. if you play to them in even the slightest and acknowledge that crypto is driven by tribal roots, you can guys could easily move forward in bigger ways that you could imagine

if you do this, 95% of the criticism which comes your way on these issues will disappear overnight
